arguments.summary: Priya Raman led an operations check-in on the Elm Street site, the Foundation budget, the hamper drive, zoning and lease signing. The team agreed to go with Elm Street, and Priya will draft the lease letter by December 1. Who signs the lease is still open, pending a bylaws check.

sections.heading: Elm Street site
points: Elm Street was the only one of three options with a loading dock.
The rent works if the Foundation grant comes through.

sections.heading: Foundation budget
points: Marcus, as treasurer, has the revised numbers the Foundation wants by next Friday.

sections.heading: Hamper drive
points: About ten more volunteers are needed for the hamper drive.
Sam said he will run the raffle again this year.

sections.heading: Zoning
points: Gabe from the City's parks department said Elm Street is zoned for warehouse use.
Gabe will email the zoning letter this week.

sections.heading: Lease signing
points: Whether the board or the executive director signs the lease is unsettled.

sections.heading: Walk-in freezer
points: The walk-in freezer warranty expires soon and its coverage is unchecked.
The switch to Northern Cold as freezer supplier was approved last month.

arguments.text: Go with the Elm Street site.
Does the board sign the Elm Street lease, or can the executive director sign it?
Draft the lease letter for Elm Street
Send the revised budget to the Foundation
Put out a call to recruit about ten volunteers for the hamper drive
Run the raffle again this year
Email the zoning letter for Elm Street
Ask Jo-Anne Mackenzie to check the bylaws on who signs the lease
Check what the walk-in freezer warranty covers

arguments.evidence: Hi everyone, Priya here, thanks for making time.
As treasurer I've got the revised numbers
From the volunteer side we're short about ten people for the hamper drive.

arguments.name: Gabe
arguments.evidence: Gabe from the City's parks department, I can speak to the zoning question.

arguments.text: Okay, so we agree we go with Elm Street. I'll draft the lease letter by December 1st.
I'll send the revised budget to them before then.
I can put out a call and recruit them over the next two weeks.
